description: Login flow: wait for onboarding to fully load, navigate to login, enter credentials, submit

actions.description: Wait for splash screen Firebase init + onboarding carousel to fully render (cold start is slow on Test Lab)
Tap the Login link — contentDescription confirmed from actions.json seq 9 and seq 21
Wait for login screen to fully render and accessibility tree to populate
Enter phone number — groupViewChildPosition 0 = first EditText on the login screen (the phone field). No Semantics wrapper on this field so it is the raw EditText node.
Wait for phone field controller and UK formatter to process input

Enter password — groupViewChildPosition:1 targets the second android.widget.EditText on screen (index 0 = phone field, index 1 = password field). Log confirmed the Semantics wrapper creates an outer android.view.View at mode_specific_sequence 0.0.0.0.0.0.0.1.8 and the inner EditText at 0.0.0.0.0.0.0.1.9 — contentDescription selector hits the outer non-clickable View (component_type:2, no ACTION_SET_TEXT), not the EditText (component_type:5). Using className+groupViewChildPosition directly targets the editable node, same mechanism that works for the phone field at index 0.
Wait for password field and _canLogin to evaluate to true
Tap Log in button — contentDescription 'Log in' confirmed from actions.json seq 13
Wait for Firebase auth and navigation to home screen (loginWithTestCredential has a 45s timeout)
Tap Connect tab — contentDescription 'Connect' set by Semantics(label: label) in _NavItem
Wait for Connect tab to load
Wait for Discover tab to load
Wait for Market tab to load
Wait for Profile tab to load
Return to Home tab for free Robo crawl
Wait on Home screen for Robo to crawl content
